title: Trump administration to announce rules for how states will share the Colorado River
script: This is World Pulse Daily with a quick news update. The key update now being reported is: Trump administration to announce rules for how states will share the Colorado River. In simple words, This week the federal government is to release new rules for how much water each of the seven states that share the Colorado River will get. Effects on the ecosystem were largely left unconsidered Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
